children: Commercial vehicle maker Tata Motors Ltd said Friday shareholders of Iveco Group have approved all resolutions of its board on the automaker's voluntary public tender offer for the Italian truck and bus maker, marking a key step towards completing the acquisition. Shareholders approved resolutions relating to the offer by TML CV Holdings Pte , acting via TML CV Holdings , for all issued ordinary shares of Iveco.

title: TaMo Nears Iveco Takeover
